# Lucy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) (sibling), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Lucy is a lovely child with a straight nose, gentle, mild hazel eyes, and long, sleek curls that are always perfectly neat. She maintains an immaculate, genteel appearance, wearing a crisp, starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032)_

## Personality

Lucy is described as an amiable, dependable, and hard-working individual who finds contentment in assisting with various chores. Characterized by her calm, well-behaved, and proper demeanor, she conducts herself with extreme rigidity and decorum, remaining quiet and modest in formal settings unless spoken to. Her approach to tasks is systematic, careful, unemotional, and tidy, allowing her to remember all of her responsibilities and learn instructions after hearing them only once.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +4 more_

## History

After becoming an orphan alongside her twin brother [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), Lucy was brought by [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Shortly after her arrival, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) enticed her outside during an [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting, tricking her into jumping into a pigpen and leaving her drenched. On another occasion, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked Lucy inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, prompting a desperate search before she was found. She later started attending school, where she was terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts, and eventually secured a permanent home at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after her relative [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md) passed away and left a trust fund for the twins.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

Lucy and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) are twin siblings who were brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) together after being orphaned. [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) frequently targets Lucy with mischievous tricks and pranks, such as enticing her outside to jump into a pigpen and get soaked under a water pump. On another occasion, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked Lucy inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, prompting a desperate search by the household before she was found.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +17 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +6 more</sub>

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) took in Lucy and her twin brother to raise at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after the death of their mother. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) actively cares for Lucy's well-being and upbringing, taking charge of searching for her and disciplining [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) when Lucy was locked in a toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +9 more_

- Relative of — raised her upon mother's death  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>
